requirements.title: EPSILON argument is real scalar or array
requirements.definition: X shall be real and may be a scalar or an array.

pending.EPSILON-X-real: Positive plan calls EPSILON with real scalar and real array arguments; source-control mutation changes X to integer and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.EPSILON-X-scalar-or-array: Positive plan calls EPSILON with scalar and rank-one real ARRAY arguments and asserts the result is scalar in both cases.

requirements.title: EPSILON result is scalar with X type and kind
requirements.definition: The EPSILON result is scalar and has the same real type and kind type parameter as X.

pending.EPSILON-result-scalar: Assign EPSILON of a rank-one real array to a scalar initialized to a negative sentinel and assert the scalar value changes to a positive model value.
pending.EPSILON-result-same-real-kind-as-X: Use default real and a larger real kind where available; assert KIND(EPSILON(X)) equals KIND(X) and mutate X kind to change the expected kind.

requirements.title: EPSILON returns b to the 1-p for X's real model
requirements.definition: EPSILON(X) has value b**(1-p), where b and p are the radix and precision of the model representing numbers of X type and kind.

pending.EPSILON-model-b-to-one-minus-p: Use RADIX(X) and DIGITS(X) to compute REAL(RADIX(X),KIND(X))**(1-DIGITS(X)) and assert equality to EPSILON(X); also assert the value is positive so a zero sentinel cannot pass.
pending.EPSILON-distinguishes-real-kinds: Where two real kinds with different DIGITS are available, assert the two EPSILON results differ consistently with their b**(1-p) model values; otherwise guard the kind-distinction branch and still test the default kind formula.
